6:157.text: Or lest you say, "If only the Scripture had been revealed to us, we would have been better guided than they." So there has

come to you a clear evidence from your Lord and a guidance and mercy. Then who is more unjust than one who denies the verses of Allāh and turns away from them? We will recompense those who turn away from Our verses with the worst of punishment for their having turned away.
